public_rationale: Marcus's February 2020 paper warned that increasing data and computation alone would leave important limitations in achieving reliable intelligence [e1]. It advocated hybrid neuro-symbolic architectures and rich cognitive models [e1]. This supports his retrospective description when 'foresaw all this' means a general warning about scaling's limitations [e1].
limitations: Support depends on interpreting 'foresaw all this' as a general warning, rather than a specific prediction of the 2026 Meta and xAI developments.
The paper documents Marcus's earlier arguments; it does not establish that those corporate developments vindicated his technical position [e1].
